    historicHarvest.Rmd

    historicHarvest

    historicHarvest replays the harvest that actually happened, year by year, in a LandR (Biomass_core) simulation that starts in 1985, and replants each cut pixel with the species SCANFI shows growing there afterwards. It is for runs that must reproduce the real landscape history (for example, attributing fire regime change to climate, harvest and fuel).

    The module does three things, and only these:

    1. Each year it writes sim$rstCurrentHarvest (1 = cut this year), read from CanLaD.
    2. It writes the two small objects disturbanceMgmt::processPartialDist() needs to remove every cohort in those pixels.
    3. It supplies the settings (minCoverThreshold, sppEquivCol, initialB) that timberSupply::plantHistoricHarvest() uses to replant the cut pixels. That function lives in the timberSupply package, so a disturbance specification can name it as a string.

    Removal is not done here. Biomass_genericDisturbance runs disturbanceMgmt::processPartialDist() right after this module’s harvest event, and then runs timberSupply::plantHistoricHarvest().

    Where harvest comes from

    CanLaD, Canada Landsat Disturbance including forest insect pest (v1.1, published 2026-05-14; Perbet et al.): https://open.canada.ca/data/en/dataset/902801fd-4d9d-4df4-9e95-319e429545cc. The module reads the annual rasters, one 30 m file per year, 1985 to 2025:

    https://ftp.maps.canada.ca/pub/nrcan_rncan/Forests_Foret/canlad_including_insect_defoliation/v1.1/TS_FinalFilter_20260508/canlad_annual_<year>_v1_1_20260508.tif

    (0 = not disturbed, 1 = wildfire, 2 = harvesting, 3 = other, 4 = water, 5 = defoliation and harvesting, 6-8 = defoliation). Only the file of the current year is fetched, with reproducible::prepInputs() cropped to rasterToMatch, and the result is Cached. Parameter harvestClasses (default c(2, 5): harvest, and defoliation followed by harvest) says which classes are harvest.

    CanLaD is 30 m and the simulation’s pixels are bigger. A pixel is cut when at least harvestMinFraction (default 0.5) of its CanLaD pixels are harvest.

    Replanting

    timberSupply::plantHistoricHarvest(sim) plants, in each pixel cut this year, every species whose SCANFI cover in that pixel is above minCoverThreshold (default 5, the same as Biomass_borealDataPrep) and that has maxB in the pixel’s ecoregion. The SCANFI snapshot is the first of 1985, 1990, …, 2025 at or after the harvest year; harvest after 2020 uses 2025. SCANFI layers come from LandR::prepSpeciesLayers_SCANFI() with the arguments Biomass_borealDataPrep uses (sppEquiv, sppEquivCol, thresh = 10), and the cohorts are inserted by LandR::updateCohortDataPostHarvest(trackPlanting = TRUE): age 2, initialB (10) g/m2, planted = TRUE. A cut pixel with no species above the threshold is left with no cohorts.

    Using it with Biomass_genericDisturbance

    processPartialDist() takes a raster of where (partialDistLoc, 1 = disturbed) and a table of which cohorts (partialDistTable: speciesCode, distYear, and the age window ageMin, ageMax). It removes the cohorts in the table whose species and age fit, from the pixels in the raster; replanting = FALSE turns off its own replanting. The module writes both objects, with every species in cohortData, ages 0 to the integer maximum, and this year as distYear, so every cohort in a cut pixel is removed. Biomass_genericDisturbance finds the arguments cohortData, pixelGroupMap, partialDistLoc and partialDistTable in the simList by name.

    In a year without harvest the three objects are NULL, and triggerObj = "rstCurrentHarvest" skips the disturbance. (processPartialDist() treats an all-NA raster as “every pixel”, so it must not run on an empty year.)

    Biomass_genericDisturbance = list(
  disturbances = list(
    ## 1. remove every cohort in the pixels cut this year
    list(fn = disturbanceMgmt::processPartialDist,
         name = "harvestRemove",
         after = "historicHarvest", afterEvent = "harvest",
         triggerObj = "rstCurrentHarvest",
         args = list(replanting = FALSE)),
    ## 2. replant them from SCANFI; offset 0.2 runs it after the removal (offset 0.1)
    list(fn = "timberSupply::plantHistoricHarvest",
         name = "harvestPlant",
         after = "historicHarvest", afterEvent = "harvest", offset = 0.2,
         triggerObj = "rstCurrentHarvest")
  )
)

    The second fn is a string because Biomass_genericDisturbance evaluates it without the simList, so it cannot reach this module’s functions; timberSupply::plantHistoricHarvest() is in a package. It takes sim first, so Biomass_genericDisturbance hands it sim and keeps what it returns. Its minCoverThreshold, sppEquivCol, initialB and studyAreaName arguments default to this module’s parameters of the same names (.studyAreaName); put them in the specification’s args to set them there.

    The two disturbances must stay together: removal alone leaves pixels pointing at pixel groups that have no cohorts, and plantHistoricHarvest() is what clears them.

    Fire regeneration does not touch harvested pixels

    Biomass_regeneration acts only on the pixels of sim$rstCurrentBurn greater than 0 (FireDisturbance(), which(as.vector(sim$rstCurrentBurn[]) > 0)). This module does not write rstCurrentBurn, so harvested pixels get no fire regeneration unless they also burned. The test the module does not touch rstCurrentBurn checks that this module’s metadata has no rstCurrentBurn.

    Timing

    The harvest event runs every year from .runInitialTime (default start(sim)) at priority 2: before Biomass_regeneration’s fireDisturbance (3), the fire modules (5.13) and growth, so a year’s harvest is in place before that year’s fire. CanLaD dates an autumn disturbance to the next year (CanLaD readme, limitation 7); the module uses CanLaD’s years as given.

    Parameters

    Parameter Default Meaning
    canladUrl CanLaD v1.1 folder Folder of the annual rasters; NA uses files already in inputPath(sim)
    canladFile canlad_annual_%d_v1_1_20260508.tif File name, %d = year
    harvestClasses c(2, 5) CanLaD classes treated as harvest: 2 harvest, 5 defoliation followed by harvest (salvage)
    harvestMinFraction 0.5 Fraction of 30 m pixels that makes a simulation pixel cut
    .runInitialTime start(sim) Time of the first harvest event (e.g. 1986 in a run that starts at SCANFI 1985, which already shows 1985’s cuts)
    minCoverThreshold 5 SCANFI cover (%) a species must exceed to be planted
    sppEquivCol "LandR" Species naming column of sppEquiv; must match Biomass_borealDataPrep
    initialB 10 Biomass of a planted cohort

    Inputs and outputs

    Inputs (from the LandR modules): rasterToMatch, sppEquiv, cohortData, pixelGroupMap, ecoregionMap, speciesEcoregion. Outputs: rstCurrentHarvest, partialDistLoc, partialDistTable.
